Chapter 7109: No Need For A Savior

Chapter 7109: No Need For A Savior

“I don’t think wolves would want to get close to someone as lazy and pathetic.” Li Qiye said.

“Old man, you’re going too far!” He gritted his teeth.

“I was more than merciful with you.” Li Qiye said.

“Alright, alright, I’m scared now, are you happy?” He raised his hands in surrender.

“Anything else?” Li Qiye asked.

“No, nothing.” He scratched his head before looking around and whispering: “Old man, you’re not really doing this to them, right?”

He made a snapping gesture with both hands.

“Who?” Li Qiye frowned.

“Who else but the villainous heaven, or Hidden Immortal?” He said.

“Why shouldn’t I?” Li Qiye asked.

“How should I put this? I kind of like the villainous heaven, it would be too cruel.” He said: “As for Hidden Immortal, this person doesn’t give off a bad vibe either.”

“If you want to be a good person, become a true immortal first.” Li Qiye said.

“I suppose it’s not my life, you can snap them if you want.” He said: “Don’t worry, old man, I’m always on your side, you have my support.”

“I need your support? I don’t mind breaking your teeth if you oppose me.” Li Qiye said.

“Don’t misunderstand, old man, I still like living. If you point west, I will go west, not east.” He waved his hands.

“Honestly, it doesn’t sound too bad.” Li Qiye said: “It gives me an excuse to imprison you until grand completion.”

“Don’t, don’t.” He waved his hand and said: “Don’t be so tyrannical when I’m such an obedient child. All I want is an easy life.”

“An easy life when the calamity is coming?” Li Qiye said.

“Am I not preparing for it? I just need to wrap myself in the blanket and nothing else matters.” He said.

“Is that so?” Li Qiye said.

“Well, I might do a bit more because I can’t just watch everyone die. Maybe I’ll dig a pit as part of the resistance. Old man, shouldn’t you give me your best treasures to guarantee my survival?” He asked.

“Just jumping into the pit is enough.” Li Qiye said.

“Well, I don’t want to suffer for too long. Why don’t you show mercy to all living beings, giving them a chance?” He asked.

“No, they have their own fate.” Li Qiye answered immediately.

“Isn’t choosing to watch inhumane when you can prevent it?” He lamented.

“Here’s your opportunity to save them all.” Li Qiye said.

“Well, would be a rather bitter experience, and the world doesn’t need a savior, I shouldn’t interfere.” He smiled wryly.

“Don’t know until you try, maybe you’re the right one.” Li Qiye said.

“Is that a joke? That’s akin to telling me to go to war against the villainous heaven. Even if I survive, I might take a serious beating while gaining nothing. I’ve changed my mind, I agree with your view the most, saviors will destroy worlds.”

“The solution to this is to save the world from the calamity and then leave. At that point, you will be an actual savior.” Li Qiye said.

“I don’t want to leave this world, I love it since it is full of joy as long as I can be lazy.” He said.

“No more joy once it is destroyed.” Li Qiye uttered coldly.

“I’m sure you will do something before you leave.” He cozied up to Li Qiye and said.

“Scram.” Li Qiye said.

“Old man, don’t tell me you really won’t do anything.” He said.

“I could also destroy it, there’s no difference between saving or otherwise.” Li Qiye said.

“I suppose, a fight between you two might destroy everything.” He touched his shiny head.

“Won’t be difficult to do.” Li Qiye said.

“Then can you two keep a distance?” He asked.

“Why does this cycle matter more than the countless previous ones?” Li Qiye asked.

“That’s a matter of the past, and you aren’t living in the past.” He said.

“I can live in any world, and can revert any destroyed world to the original state.” Li Qiye patted his shoulder.

“Total temporal reversal?” He asked.

Li Qiye smiled and left.

“Old man, you have to protect this world. My happiness depends on it!” He shouted after Li Qiye.
